notes: Stop Program Change numbers are not published per stop for this model (the manual only says they depend on the number and order of the stops): use Learn every stop. Each stop Program Change toggles the stop.

Check on your organ: the division channels can be changed in the organ's MIDI menu. The manual does not say which channel carries CC11 (expression) or CC7 (general volume): CC11 is assumed on the Swell's channel and CC7 on channel 1.
Dutch-market model with Dutch stop names as printed; several tabs have sample-style alternates (e.g. Terts 1 3/5' / Sifflet 1', Mixtuur / Carillon, Trompet / Hobo, Octaaf 4' / Salicionaal 8').
Mixtuur/Cornet ranks are not published (entered without ranks; Cornet entered at 8'). The 30-note pedal compass is assumed.

MIDI scheme: The Opus 260/360 manual needs a dealer login; MIDI scheme from the Studio 280/380 user manual (February 2024), MIDI specifications p. 43 (three-manual: Choir 1, Great 2, Swell 3, Pedal 4, stops 12): https://hq.globalorgangroup.com/service/scripts/customer.fcgi/getAttachment/47185-OFj15DYZZASjMi8Pu6CMGcg2aZYBALyRHD6Y6FWUbyOHj87aAggnNUS5fDbQnpQJ-0/Studio%20280-380%20Usermanual.pdf
